title: GoTodo
description: GoTodo API: traffic, latency, auth, Go runtime, process and SQLite pool.

panels.title: Requests / s
panels.description: API requests per second, all routes in the selection.

panels.title: 5xx errors
panels.description: Share of requests answered with a server error (5xx).

targets.expr: (sum (rate(gotodo_http_requests_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route", code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) or 0 * sum (rate(gotodo_http_requests_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval]))) / sum (rate(gotodo_http_requests_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: 4xx responses
panels.description: Share of requests rejected as client errors (4xx): validation, auth, not found.

targets.expr: (sum (rate(gotodo_http_requests_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route", code=~"4.."}[$__rate_interval])) or 0 * sum (rate(gotodo_http_requests_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval]))) / sum (rate(gotodo_http_requests_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: 95th percentile request duration.

panels.title: In flight
panels.description: Requests being served right now (sampled at scrape time).

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since the (most recently started) gotodo process started.

panels.title: Requests / s by status class
panels.description: Stacked. 2xx green, 4xx orange, 5xx red.

panels.title: Errors / s by route and code
panels.description: 4xx and 5xx responses only.

targets.expr: sum by (route, code) (rate(gotodo_http_requests_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route", code=~"[45].."}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Latency percentiles
panels.description: Request duration across the selected routes.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, route) (rate(gotodo_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Routes (selected time range)
panels.description: Per-route totals over the dashboard time range. Click a header to sort.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, route) (rate(gotodo_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route"}[$__range])))

(sum by (route) (rate(gotodo_http_requests_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route", code=~"4.."}[$__range])) or 0 * sum by (route) (rate(gotodo_http_requests_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route"}[$__range]))) / sum by (route) (rate(gotodo_http_requests_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route"}[$__range]))

(sum by (route) (rate(gotodo_http_requests_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route", code=~"5.."}[$__range])) or 0 * sum by (route) (rate(gotodo_http_requests_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route"}[$__range]))) / sum by (route) (rate(gotodo_http_requests_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Failed login share
panels.description: Share of login attempts with wrong credentials. A jump can mean password guessing.

panels.title: Heap
panels.description: In use: live heap spans. Next GC: heap size that triggers the next collection.

panels.title: Allocation rate
panels.description: Bytes allocated on the heap per second. Drives GC frequency.

panels.title: GC pause
panels.description: Stop-the-world pause durations over recent cycles.

panels.title: Time spent in GC pauses
panels.description: Share of wall-clock time the program was paused for GC.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: 100% = one full core.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Resident set size vs. memory the Go runtime obtained from the OS.

panels.title: Open file descriptors
panels.description: Includes client connections and the SQLite files.

panels.title: Network
panels.description: Bytes received (+) and sent (-) by the process.

panels.title: Connections
panels.description: The pool is capped at one connection (SQLite has a single writer).

panels.title: Connection waits / s
panels.description: Queries that had to wait because the connection was busy.
